extDescription.message: Sync scrolling, clicks and hover between the two tabs of a Chrome Split View. Made for comparing live and staging sites.

cmdSyncCurrent.message: Start sync for the current Split View

cmdSyncAll.message: Start sync for all Split Views in this window

cmdStopCurrent.message: Stop sync for the current Split View

statusPausedBody.message: Split View found. Start sync to link both panes.

statusReloadingBody.message: A pane is reloading. Sync picks up again when it's done.

statusErrorBody.message: Reload the other pane, then start sync again.

statusNoSplitBody.message: Put two web pages side by side to compare them.

emptyStep1.message: Right-click a tab and choose “Add tab to new split view”.

emptyStep2.message: Pick the second page. Both must be regular websites (http or https).

emptyStep3.message: Open this menu again and press Start sync.

statusUnsupportedBody.message: Chrome pages, the Web Store and local files are closed to extensions. Open a regular website in a Split View.

sectionThisSplitHelp.message: Changes apply to both panes right away.

optNavigationHelp.message: Opens the same path on the other side, only between the two synced sites.

optClicksHelp.message: Repeats clicks on the matching element. Never on forms, payment or delete actions.

optHoverHelp.message: Shows hover styles and hover menus on both sides.

optCursorHelp.message: Shows a pointer in the other pane where your mouse is. Only shows, never clicks.

optWpAdminBarHelp.message: Hides the toolbar while syncing so both layouts line up.

sectionDefaultsHelp.message: Used when a new pair is found. Existing pairs keep their own settings.

optAlwaysShowHelp.message: Turn off to show the floating button only when you choose to.

offsetHelp.message: The right pane scrolls this many pixels further than the left.

hardReloadLeftLabel.message: Hard reload left pane, bypassing the cache

hardReloadRightLabel.message: Hard reload right pane, bypassing the cache

rulerLabel.message: Ruler line. Drag to move, press Delete to remove.

toastNoPair.message: No Split View pair found. Try again in a moment.

statusOriginPausedTitle.message: Paused: a different site was opened

statusOriginPausedBody.message: One pane left the site you started sync for. Press Start sync to sync these two sites.

needPairHint.message: Open two web pages in a Split View to use this.

altHint.message: Tip: hold Alt (Option) while scrolling to move one side on its own; the difference becomes the offset.

optAlignHelp.message: Pixel-exact copies the scroll position. On element/content keeps the same section at the top when the pages differ in height.

optContainersHelp.message: Also scrolls the matching scrollable area on the other side: side panels, modals, lists.

optZoomHelp.message: Zooming one side (Ctrl/⌘ + or −) zooms the other side to the same level.

optInputHelp.message: Copies what you type and pick in form fields to the matching field on the other side. The other site receives that text. Never passwords, codes, payment or file fields; never submits.

paneSizesHelp.message: Chrome has no setting for the divider, so a preset resizes the window until the chosen pane has that width. The other pane changes along.

presetReached.message: The $SIDE$ pane is now $WIDTH$ px wide.

presetLimited.message: Not enough room on the screen: the $SIDE$ pane is $WIDTH$ px wide.

presetFailed.message: The window could not be resized.

checklistHelp.message: Paths to check one by one on both sites. Saved for this pair of sites.

checklistEmpty.message: No pages yet. Paste paths or URLs below, or add the current page.

checklistNoCurrent.message: Press Next to open the first page in both panes.

checklistNeedSync.message: Start sync once so both sites are known; then Previous/Next opens the pages.

checklistPasteLabel.message: Paths or URLs, one per line

historyHelp.message: Pairs you started sync for. Click one to open both pages side by side again.

historyEmpty.message: Pairs appear here after you press Start sync.

historyReused.message: Loading both pages into this Split View. Sync starts when they are loaded.

historyCreated.message: Opened as a new Split View. Sync starts when both pages are loaded.

historyManual.message: Both pages are open next to each other. Select both tabs (click one, Shift-click the other), right-click and choose the split view option, then press Start sync.

historyFailed.message: This pair could not be opened.

optRememberPairsHelp.message: Keeps the sites and paths (no query strings) of pairs you sync, on this device only.

overlayHelp.message: Lays an image of one side over the other side, so differences stand out. The image is refreshed when you stop scrolling.

overlayPanelHelp.message: An image of the other side, on top of this side.

overlayPermissionHelp.message: Chrome only lets an extension take a picture of a tab with access to all sites, so the overlay asks for that once. The picture stays inside your browser.

overlayNeedPermission.message: Allow capturing the panes first: toolbar menu → Compare.

overlayNeedSync.message: Start sync to use the overlay.

overlayShowHere.message: Show the other side over this side

overlayDifferenceHelp.message: Identical pixels turn black; differences light up.

overlaySwipeHelp.message: Drag the divider on the page to compare both sides at one spot.

overlayDeclined.message: Without that permission the overlay cannot capture the other pane.

cmdToggleInspect.message: Inspect CSS differences on or off

inspectHelp.message: Point at an element on one side: both sides outline it and a panel lists the CSS that differs (font, size, colour, spacing, layout). Click to freeze, Esc to stop.

inspectNoMatch.message: No matching element on the other side.

inspectSame.message: No differences in the checked properties.

inspectHint.message: Click to freeze · Esc to stop

inspectHintFrozen.message: Frozen · click to continue · Esc to stop

suggestNever.message: Don't suggest for this pair again

suggestWhy.message: Looks like two versions of the same site.

optSuggestHelp.message: Offers to start sync when both panes look like two versions of one site (same page, or live and staging). Never starts by itself.

suggestResetDone.message: Dismissed pairs will be suggested again.
